teams_key_format.name: teams_key_format
teams_key_format.value: key GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*' AND length(key) BETWEEN 2 AND 6

views_order_dir_check.name: views_order_dir_check
views_order_dir_check.value: order_dir IS NULL OR order_dir IN ('asc','desc')

workspaces_slug_format.name: workspaces_slug_format
workspaces_slug_format.value: slug GLOB '[a-z0-9-][a-z0-9-][a-z0-9-]*' AND length(slug) BETWEEN 3 AND 40
